text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Good work. Right now, I am offering 
detailed explanations of the "U.A.F." to 
anyone interested—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: <username>, do you need an explanation?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what would you like me to 
explain?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to what you'd like to know 
about "U.A.F." training—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: About the "U.A.F.," right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The "U.A.F." is a new comprehensive sports 
competition where Umamusume push their 
physical limits!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Competing for victory in 15 unique events, 
made possible only by the physical prowess 
of Umamusume――

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Based on those overall results, this 
tournament will decide the No. 1 Athlete 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The U.A.F. consists of a total of three 
stages. First is the TEST STAGE, which 
serves as the test tournament.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Next, the three TRIALS STAGE qualifying 
rounds leading up to the finals—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And the final tournament that only those 
who made it through the qualifiers can 
enter, the SHOW DOWN.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
These three stages will be held over the 
course of three years.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To achieve victory in each U.A.F. 
discipline, it is vital to conduct daily 
discipline training and raise your 
Discipline Levels.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Achieving great results in the U.A.F. 
leads to significant growth for the 
Umamusume, so be sure to raise as many 
Discipline Levels as possible!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Also, lest you forget... You are all 
students of Tracen Academy. Above all 
else, racing is your primary duty.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Therefore, all of you will be competing 
in the 'U.A.F.' while simultaneously 
taking part in the Twinkle Series."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please note that depending on training 
conditions, your training may conclude 
even while "U.A.F." is still in progress.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation of the 
"U.A.F." Is there anything else you'd like 
to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You'd like to know about “Competitive 
Training,” right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
This time, we will take on event 
training—a new form of training geared 
toward the U.A.F.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
“In Discipline Training, you can hone a 
wide variety of fundamental abilities as 
an athlete.”

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
This will definitely come in handy when 
all of you run in races, so please make 
sure to tackle it proactively.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
“There are 15 types of Discipline Training 
in total, and 5 are randomly selected each 
turn.”

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
“Performing Discipline Training will raise 
its respective Discipline Lv.”

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
“Discipline Training is categorized into 
three genres: 'Sphere', 'Fight', and 
'Free'.”

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If a Sport Training session of the same 
genre as the one you executed exists on 
the same turn, Link Training will be 
triggered.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
During Link Training, the Event Levels for 
all event trainings in the same category 
will increase, and the Umamusume's basic 
stats will increase significantly more!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Also, Discipline Lv depends on the number 
of Umamusume participating in training 
together, and—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Increases more significantly the more 
Scenario Link characters there are.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Make good use of Link Training to 
efficiently raise Event Levels and your 
Umamusume's stats!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Also, if you choose to rest, race, or go 
out—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
When that happens, the training equipment 
will undergo maintenance, increasing the 
Sport Lv gain from the next turn's 
training.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation regarding 
“Competitive Training.” Is there anything 
else you'd like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Let's go over "Heat Up."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
“By doing Discipline Training, whenever 
the total Discipline Lv for a genre 
exceeds a certain value, the Umamusume's 
training enthusiasm will Heat Up!”

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
When Heat Up is triggered, special effects 
corresponding to each genre—"Sphere," 
"Fight," and "Free"—will activate—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The effects of your training will be 
boosted for a set number of times!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"The number of enhancements granted by 
this Heat Up will not decrease even if you 
Rest or Go Out."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fire up the Umamusume's passion and guide 
them to greater heights as athletes!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation for "Heat 
Up." Is there anything else you'd like to 
ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Regarding "Consultations," correct?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
By consulting with Sonon Elfie, the 
promotional character of the U.A.F., 
regarding training—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can change the training content for 
this turn's event.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Consultations are extremely effective 
when you want to deliberately trigger a 
Link Training."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
However, Sonon Elfie-san is very busy, so 
the number of times you can consult her 
within a certain period is limited...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Also, when moving on to the next period, 
such as when the tournament progresses to 
the next stage, remaining consultations 
cannot be carried over.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Be sure to make use of your chances to 
consult at the right timing so you don't 
miss out!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"That concludes the explanation regarding 
‘Consultations.’ Is there anything else 
you'd like to ask?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Are you truly all right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood♪ Just to be sure, I have a 
brief summary right here.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can review that explanation at any 
time by tapping the 'i' button in the top 
left.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, best of luck. I'll be cheering 
you on quietly.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood. In that case, do your best, 
okay? I'll be quietly cheering you on.
